item.title: 'You couldn't ask for a nicer man' | Village Perks coffee shop donating proceeds to support stabbed deputy
item.description: Village Perks owner Cindy Wilson said Deputy Mark Farthing always orders the same thing, so now people can order the "Farthing's Caramel Mocha" to support him and his family as he recovers.

item.title: 'Kentucky-born, Kentucky-raised' | Northern Kentucky's first medical marijuana dispensary opens in Florence
item.description: After a statewide rollout spanning years, Northern Kentucky saw its first medical marijuana dispensary, Bluegrass Cannacare, open on Saturday to patients in Florence.

item.title: CFD: Pilot performs emergency belly landing at Lunken Airport, crews investigating
item.description: A pilot was forced to perform an emergency belly landing at Lunken Airport Saturday after experiencing landing gear failure during final approach.
